abilities.name: Rally the Tribes
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: If there is a friendly Darkoath Hero on the battlefield, pick a friendly non-Hero non-Unique Darkoath unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 3" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: United in Darkness
abilities.effect: While there is at least 1 friendly Warriors of Chaos Hero and 1 other friendly Daemon Hero or Darkoath Hero on the battlefield, add 2 to the control scores of friendly Slaves to Darkness units while they are contesting an objective that is wholly outside friendly territory.

abilities.name: Feral Ruin
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Daemon Prince to use this ability. Then, pick a visible non-Daemon non-Unique Slaves to Darkness unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove any Pledge to Chaos keywords the target has. Then, the target gains any Pledge to Chaos keywords this unit has.

abilities.name: Ironclad Onslaught
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an objective that is contested by any friendly units to be the target.
abilities.effect: Place a defiled token next to the target objective. Then, roll a D3 for each enemy unit contesting an objective that has a friendly defiled token. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Devotees of Ruin
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Warriors of Chaos unit. Then, pick up to 2 visible friendly Darkoath units that do not have a Pledge to Chaos keyword and are wholly within 12" of that Warriors of Chaos unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the targets have the same Pledge to Chaos keyword as that Warriors of Chaos unit.

abilities.name: Paragons of Darkness
abilities.effect: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly non-Monster Slaves to Darkness Heroes.

abilities.name: Pledge to Chaos
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-Unique Slaves to Darkness unit that does not already have one of the keywords below to be the target.
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the following Pledge to Chaos keywords: • Pledged to Khorne: • Pledged to Tzeentch: • Pledged to Nurgle: • Pledged to Slaanesh: The target has that keyword for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Eye of the Gods
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-Unique Warriors of Chaos or Darkoath Hero to be the target.
abilities.effect: During the battle, the target gains Dark Apotheosis points as follows: • Each time the target uses a Fight ability, it gains D3 Dark Apotheosis points. • At the end of each of your turns, if the target is contesting an objective that is wholly outside friendly territory, it gains D3 Dark Apotheosis points.

abilities.name: Dark Apotheosis
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit with 8 or more Dark Apotheosis points to be the target.
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the following. ***Aura of Chaos:* Heal(X) the target, where X is the number of damage points allocated to the target. In addition, the target has Ward (5+) for the rest of the battle. *Daemonhood:* Set up a Daemon Prince within 1" of the target. Then, remove the target from the battlefield. If the target is your general, the Daemon Prince becomes your general instead and is added to your general's regiment. If the target has any enhancements, the Daemon Prince has those enhancements instead. If the target has a Pledge to Chaos keyword, the Daemon Prince has the same keyword. Otherwise, pick 1 Pledge to Chaos keyword for the Daemon Prince** to have for the rest of the battle If any Manifestations that were summoned by the target are on the battlefield, those Manifestations are removed from play.

abilities.name: Pledged to Tzeentch
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Pledged to Tzeentch unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 2D6. Then pick a point within a number of inches of the target equal to the roll. Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of that point and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Pledged to Khorne
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly Pledged to Khorne units.

abilities.name: Pledged to Nurgle
abilities.effect: Friendly Pledged to Nurgle units have Ward (6+). If a unit already has Ward (6+), it has Ward (5+) instead.

abilities.name: Pledged to Slaanesh
abilities.timing: Your Charge Phase
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, when making charge rolls for friendly Pledged to Slaanesh units, you can roll 1 additional dice (to a maximum of 3), but if you do, you must discard 1 dice of your choice.

powers.name: Binding Damnation
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Slaves to Darkness Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
powers.effect: The target has Strike-last until the start of your next turn.

powers.name: Daemonic Speed
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Slaves to Darkness Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly Slaves to Darkness unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
powers.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a maximum of 3.

powers.name: Spite-tongue Curse
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Slaves to Darkness Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. If the casting attempt is unsuccessful or if the spell is unbound, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster.
powers.effect: Inflict 3 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Fuelled by Sorcery
abilities.effect: Each time a spell is successfully cast by a unit within 12" of this Manifestation, give this Manifestation 1 ruinous energy point, to a maximum of 6. Each time this Manifestation uses a Shoot ability, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its Darkfire Torrent for each ruinous energy point it has. If this Manifestation is removed from play, all of its ruinous energy points are lost.

summon.name: Summon Darkfire Daemonrift
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Darkfire Daemonrift on the battlefield, pick a friendly Slaves to Darkness Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Darkfire Daemonrift wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Empowered by Atrocity
abilities.effect: If 2 or more units (friendly or enemy) were destroyed this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly Slaves to Darkness units while they are wholly within 12" of this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Debilitating Shockwave
abilities.timing: Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this Manifestation charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If any models in the target unit are slain by this ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.

summon.name: Summon Realmscourge Rupture
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Realmscourge Rupture on the battlefield, pick a friendly Slaves to Darkness Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Realmscourge Rupture wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Scything Blade
abilities.timing: Any Movement Phase
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic in one direction (see 'The Pendulum Swings'). It can pass through models during that move and can end that move in combat. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units that this Manifestation passed across during that move or that are within 1/2" of it to be the targets. Roll a D6 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: The Pendulum Swings
abilities.effect: This Manifestation cannot use Charge or Fight abilities. In addition, when this Manifestation moves, it must move in a straight line either in the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing or in the opposite direction to the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing

summon.name: Summon Aethervoid Pendulum
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Aethervoid Pendulumon the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up an Aethervoid Pendulum wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Mechanisms of Time
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: If there are any friendly Wizards within 3" of this Manifestation, pick 1 of the following effects: *Increase Time Flow*: Until the start of your next turn, you can re-roll charge rolls for friendly units while they are wholly within 12" of this Manifestation. *Decrease Time Flow*: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly Wizards while they are wholly within 12" of this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Chronomantic Cogs
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Chronomantic Cogs endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Chronomantic Cogs endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: Dancing Blades
abilities.effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for damage points inflicted by this Manifestation's attacks.

summon.name: Summon Quicksilver Swords
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Quicksilver Swords endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Quicksilver Swords endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Harbinger of Horror
abilities.timing: Any Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that was targeted by this Manifestation's shooting attacks this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is less than the number of models in the target unit that were slain this phase, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

summon.name: Summon Horrorghast
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Horrorghast endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Horrorghast endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Traverse the Tides of Death
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Infantry Wizard Hero within 3" of this Manifestation to be the target
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, remove the target from the battlefield and set them up again on the battlefield within 3" of this Manifestation and not in combat. Then, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

summon.name: Summon Lauchon the Soulseeker

summon.effect: Set up a Lauchon the Soulseeker endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Phantasmal Translocation
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: Pick a part of this Manifestation, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 9" of the other part and more than 3" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: Ensnaring Soul-drain
abilities.effect: Each time an enemy unit uses a Move ability while it is within 9" of any parts of this Manifestation, the effects of the 'Fly' ability do not apply to that unit. Enemy units cannot be set up within 9" of either part of this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Shards of Valagharr

summon.effect: Set up a Shards of Valagharr endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Shards of Valagharr endless spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Deathly Passage

abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 6" of one part of this Manifestation to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of the other part of this Manifestation and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts

abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: If this Manifestation destroyed any enemy Manifestations this turn, Heal (6) this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Arcane Predator
abilities.effect: You can add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this Manifestation, to a maximum of 3, while it is within 18" of any enemy Manifestations, but if you do so, it must end the charge move within 1/2" of an enemy Manifestation.

abilities.name: Wild Form
abilities.effect: Each time this Manifestation is targeted by the 'Banish Manifestation' ability, if it would be banished, it is not banished. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

summon.name: Summon Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur

abilities.name: Morbid Detonation

abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, this Manifestation is destroyed.

abilities.name: Necrotic Vortex
abilities.effect: Give this Manifestation 1 maelstrom point each time: • This Manifestation is set up. • A unit successfully casts a spell while it is within 12" of this Manifestation. • A model is slain within 12" of this Manifestation. This Manifestation can have a maximum of 6 maelstrom points at once.

summon.name: Summon Malevolent Maelstrom

summon.effect: Set up a a Malevolent Maelstrom endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+: • Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. • Subtract a number of inches equal to the roll from the target's Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.

abilities.effect: This Manifestation cannot be targeted by shooting attacks. In addition, a unit cannot be targeted by shooting attacks if it is impossible to draw a straight line from a model in the attacking unit to a model in the target unit without that line passing across this Manifestation.
